initialExam.title: UPSC SO/Steno LDCE 2026
initialExam.description: Section Officer and Stenographer Grade B/C Limited Departmental Competitive Examination for promotion of existing government stenographers and assistants to higher grades.
initialExam.eligibility: Serving government Stenographers/Assistants with required service period
initialExam.qualifications: Graduate with required years of service as Stenographer/Assistant
initialExam.syllabus: General English, General Studies, Stenography Test, Office Procedure.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test (Objective + Descriptive) + Stenography Skill Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Skill Test → Merit List → Promotion
initialExam.jobRole: Section Officer, Stenographer Grade B in CSS/CSSS
initialExam.careerGrowth: Stenographer Grade C → Grade B → Grade A → Principal Private Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Apply through department 2. Fill UPSC form 3. Submit via proper channel
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension, LTC
